# Request rate
sum(rate(checkout_requests_total[5m])) by (status)

# p95 latency
histogram_quantile(0.95,
  rate(checkout_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))

# Error rate
sum(rate(checkout_requests_total{status="failed"}[5m]))
  / sum(rate(checkout_requests_total[5m]))
